title: Mount Qingcheng and the Dujiangyan Irrigation System
checked_facts: The description states construction began in the third century BC and the system continues to regulate the Minjiang and supply Chengdu plain farmland.
The Brief synthesis describes use of natural topographic and hydrological features for irrigation diversion, sediment drainage and flood control.
The Brief synthesis identifies Yuzui, Feishayan and Baopingkou as three key components and records modification and enlargement during later dynasties.
use: Source for supplied historical brief only; no extra facts were added to the writing samples.
